title: Kubernetes Pod OOMKilled & Memory Saturation
symptoms: Container exits with code 137 (OOMKilled). Restart count continuously increments. RSS memory hits 100% of limits.memory.
diagnostic_steps: Check pod status via kubectl describe pod -n production
Inspect termination reason for exit code 137 / OOMKilled
Correlate heap dump memory leak vs traffic surge spike

title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Starvation & Thread Exhaustion
symptoms: Backend services report FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections. P99 latency spikes above 4000ms.
diagnostic_steps: Check active vs max_connections allocation in PgBouncer pool
Kill orphan lingering transactions holding shared locks
remediation:
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle in transaction' AND state_change < now() - INTERVAL '60 seconds';
pd-admin pool-resize --service rds-core-db --pool-size 750 --idle-timeout 30s

title: API Gateway / Ingress 502 Bad Gateway Error Spike
symptoms: External client traffic encounters 18%+ 502/504 errors. Envoy / Nginx ingress logs upstream connect timeout.
diagnostic_steps: Verify healthy backend endpoints in TargetGroup / K8s Endpoints
Check connection keepalive and idle socket timeouts
Verify CPU throttling on upstream microservice pods
remediation:
kubectl scale deployment api-gateway-proxy -n ingress --replicas=8;
kubectl rollout restart deployment routing-mesh -n ingress

title: Redis Cache MaxMemory Saturation & Eviction Cascade
symptoms: Redis memory reaches 98.7% of maxmemory. Evicted keys rate spikes to >4000/sec, degrading primary database with un-cached queries.
diagnostic_steps: Run redis-cli INFO memory and evaluate used_memory_peak_human
Audit top volatile keys with BIGKEYS command
Verify maxmemory-policy is set to allkeys-lru or volatile-ttl
remediation:
redis-cli -h cache-cluster-01 -p 6379 CONFIG SET maxmemory-policy volatile-lru;
redis-cli -h cache-cluster-01 -p 6379 MEMORY PURGE

title: CoreDNS Resolution Degradation & UDP Packet Drop
symptoms: Internal service discovery lookups timeout (>5000ms). Pods fail to resolve postgres.internal.net with SERVFAIL.
diagnostic_steps: Verify conntrack table saturation on worker nodes
Deploy NodeLocal DNSCache daemonset to offload UDP traffic
remediation:
kubectl scale deployment coredns -n kube-system --replicas=6;
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=1048576

title: Worker Node Disk Inode & Ephemeral Volume Exhaustion
symptoms: K8s node status reports DiskPressure. Docker/containerd fails to create sandbox overlays with 'no space left on device'.
diagnostic_steps: Run df -h and df -i on affected worker nodes
Inspect dangling unused docker images and defunct container logs
